methodology.end_to_end_timer: perf_counter immediately before submitting the full task batch through completion of ray.get(refs); no ray.wait precedes the timer
methodology.end_to_end_baseline: matched task receives the same request and constructs the same SampleSet, but returns None
methodology.interpretation: payload-minus-discard contrasts include serialization, ordinary Ray delivery and materialization; the remote-minus-local difference between those contrasts is the observed node-boundary effect under this two-node load, not an isolated network term or a prediction of larger-node saturation
